description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the full lifecycle of consumer products, from identifying user opportunities to shipping polished experiences and learning from real-world usage. This role combines product strategy, design, and full-stack engineering, with direct ownership of product quality and user outcomes.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define product positioning, scope features, and identify the smallest complete version to build.

 - Design consumer experiences, including onboarding flows, interfaces, and product copy.

 - Build frontend and backend systems using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

 - Implement APIs, SQL data models, authentication, payments, and subscriptions.

 - Set up analytics, experimentation, and production monitoring to measure engagement and retention.

 - Deploy products, debug production issues, and maintain reliable core functionality.

 - Use user feedback and retention data to guide iteration and product decisions.

 - Ship polished MVPs or substantial product iterations in approximately 3 to 7 days.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience shipping consumer products end-to-end, including independently launching a live product used by real users.

 - Startup founding or early product engineering experience, with ownership across product decisions, design, and implementation.

 - Strong production experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, APIs, SQL databases, and data modeling.

 - Experience implementing authentication, payments, and subscriptions, and deploying and debugging production applications.

 - Experience designing consumer interfaces and using analytics and experiments to understand engagement and retention.

 - Comfort using AI development tools while maintaining sound architectural judgment and code quality.

 - Consumer apps, social or communication products, and cross-platform development are valuable; experience with tools such as PostHog, React Native, Electron, Flutter, WebRTC, or real-time audio and video is a plus.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 USD annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California, United States.
